entities.summary: The Palmengarten is one of two botanical gardens in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. It is located in the Westend-Süd district. It covers a surface of 22 hectares. It is a major tourist attraction. Palmengarten is a botanical garden in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
